question: What bodily condition results from the visualization described in the preceding verses?
premises: The practitioner becomes free from wrinkles and grey hair.
The practitioner becomes free from all diseases.
These are presented as outcomes of the practice.
inference: The practice results in freedom from aging signs and all diseases.
uncertainties: The gender and case agreement between the two compounds is not fully explicit in the given forms.
plain_english: One becomes freed from wrinkles and grey hair and devoid of all diseases.
